source: Live schemas, read only: Bendie project (shared with the Bendie Events app) and Bendie Planner project. Row counts are counts or planner estimates on the day.
field_level_reference: context/schema-reference.md (Bendie, field by field). The Planner field list is in 07-database-schema.md.

fragile: current_event_id: Null makes most screens empty ('No active event'); chats, posts, photos and games return nothing.
status: Exact strings 'active'/'published' gate public visibility, the scanner and walk-in; any other value hides the event publicly.
starts_at / ends_at: Decide ongoing/upcoming/past; with both null only 'active' is shown as ongoing.
slug: Key for access codes, walk-in, scanner and resend; must be lowercase-safe (the scanner lowercases it).

ACTIVE_EVENT_COLUMNS set (e.g. disabled_menu_items, networking_mode, feedback_form_url, in_house): Selected by explicit name; a dropped or renamed column makes the whole query error, so the menu, labels and networking mode fail to load.

theme_primary / theme_secondary / theme_tertiary / profile_banner_image_url: Embedded by name in the profile fetch; a rename makes the profile load fail and fall back to the default theme / fallback profile.
interests_enabled: Only an explicit false skips the interests step; null means the step is shown.
feedback_form_url: Null disables the feedback form WebView.
onboarding_status: Must equal 'completed' or the user is treated as not onboarded and re-routed to onboarding.
breakout_rooms: The only breakout source; an empty or invalid JSON hides the rooms.
starts_at: Sort key; displayed in Africa/Nairobi regardless of the event's location.
action_type: Only 'add' rows count as favourites or attendees.
title / route / travel_time / pickup_location: A row is dropped if all of these are empty; times are text columns (boarding_time, travel_time, date).
published_at: Ordering only; there is no future-date filter, so scheduled news shows immediately.
related_type / related_id / event_id: Drive push deep links and the event switch; unknown types go to /notifications.
event_id: Chats whose event_id doesn't match the active event are hidden, and sending is blocked.
content: The sentinel '__EVENTLY_DELETED_MESSAGE__' means a soft-deleted message.
min_supported_version: Setting it above the installed version blocks the app; null disables the gate.

planner.reached_via: Portal server routes with the Planner service role (src/lib/plannerAdmin.ts); never from the browser

fragile: first_name, full_name, email, role, gender: Own row must have all five non-empty or user is routed to Setup; must stay self-readable via direct select
organization_id: Null routes user to awaiting-organization holding screen
is_org_admin: Grants admin access to all org events; read from own row
email, role, is_platform_admin, member_type (other users): Selected directly on Event Access and checklist owner picker; a column revoke fails the whole query
avatar_url: Treated as bucket path unless it starts with http(s)
timezone: Required on insert/update; all venue times depend on it
(any new NOT NULL column): Planner inserts events with a fixed column set; a NOT NULL column without default breaks creation
flight, date_time, event_id: Passenger list matches flight code + date_time day range
passenger_id (FK to passengers): Embedded select passengers(full_name,gender) needs the FK relationship
start_time, is_parallel, track_name, room_name, sort_order: Define breakout slots, track filter and room label
slides_bucket_name, slides_file_path: Both required for View presentation; bucket read from the row
version_no, bucket_name: Next version computed client-side as max+1; bucket taken from existing rows
module, source_id, notification_type: Push and feed deep links parse these (task code, numeric id, '<flight>|<YYYY-MM-DD>')

bendie-events.note: Not used DIRECTLY by app code. The app may still reach these through RPCs or views (see the contract's rpcs list), e.g. Planner tasks via get_operational_tasks_for_mobile_v2.

bendie-planner.note: Not used DIRECTLY by app code. The app may still reach these through RPCs or views (see the contract's rpcs list), e.g. Planner tasks via get_operational_tasks_for_mobile_v2.
